title: Specialty Pharmacy Program Member Payment Card: Lifting a Hold Placed for an Overdue Payment
content:
## Scope

This rule of the Specialty Pharmacy Program sets the **hold-release payment**: the payment a member makes with the member's own card to lift a hold placed on a specialty enrollment for an overdue payment.

- The payment is posted against the latest shipped fill.
- Earlier fills are settled first.
- It covers the enrollment's own balance only.

## When the payment is set

The hold-release payment is not set until the latest shipped fill carries the maximizer program draw owed on it.

Put another way, while the latest shipped fill does not yet carry the maximizer program draw owed on it, no hold-release payment is set.

## What the payment does

The payment is the member's own payment, made with the member's own instrument. It posts the member's payment against the shipped fill it is applied to, and lowers the member's balance due on the enrollment by the amount paid. It does not itself change the enrollment's hold status. Afterwards the payment appears in the enrollment's payment history against that fill, and the balance due shows the reduction.

## How it is invoked

The action is `pay_hold_release_166e6883`, a tool the member runs. The agent unlocks it and hands it over to the customer themselves, meaning the member, who runs it.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `specialty_enrollment_id` | Reference number of the member's held specialty therapy enrollment, as the agent reads it out from the specialty enrollment lookup | Identifier |
| `specialty_fill_id` | Reference number of the shipped fill the payment is applied to, as the agent reads it out from the specialty fill lookup | Identifier |
| `amount` | The amount the member pays now | USD, a positive amount to 2 decimal places (nearest cent) |
| `payment_method` | The instrument the member pays with | One of: `credit_card` (a credit card); `debit_card` (a bank debit card); `hsa_fsa_card` (a health savings account or flexible spending account card); `check` (an electronic check from a checking account). `copay_card` is reserved for manufacturer program payments, and `not_applicable` is reserved for entries that are not payments; neither is ever the instrument of a member's own payment. |

## Return

On success the receipt contains:

- `status`: "posted";
- `payment_entry_id`: reference number of the member payment entry;
- `specialty_fill_id`: the fill paid;
- `amount`: the amount paid, in USD to 2 decimal places;
- `payment_method`: the instrument recorded;
- `balance_due`: the member's balance due on the enrollment after the payment, in USD to 2 decimal places.
